question:
Case Study:

The area of a triangle with vertices $(5,0)$, $(0,12)$, $(0,0)$ is calculated using determinants. Show all the steps and write the final formula.
explanation:
Area formula:

$\text{Area} = \frac{1}{2} \left| \begin{vmatrix} 5 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 12 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \end{vmatrix} \right|$

Expand:

$= \frac{1}{2}|5(12 \times 1 - 1 \times 0) - 0(0 \times 1 - 1 \times 0) + 1(0 \times 0 - 12 \times 0)|$

$= \frac{1}{2}|5 \times 12| = \frac{1}{2} \times 60 = 30$

Thus, the area is $30$ unit$^2$.
